name: Progress Diary
tagline: Keep a coherent diary of progress toward what matters.
for_whom: Anyone who wants to see their trajectory across days, weeks, and months — not just today.
outcome: Diary entries appear automatically, linked to goals, with weekly and monthly reflection prompts.
user_journey: On /wrap-up, Virgil drafts a diary entry: today's wins, what advanced, what got blocked
User reviews + edits the draft (low friction — accept, edit, or skip)
Weekly: Virgil prompts a longer reflection synthesizing the week
Monthly: Virgil surfaces patterns and trajectory across recent weeks

dependencies.goals_db: Recommended — for linking entries to goals

roadmap: Implementation planned for v1.2. Open a discussion or PR if you want to help shape the design.
